event_records.description: The quarterly review begins with the executive team meeting to discuss the balcony-panel pilot.

executive_team_collective.name: Executive Team (collective)
executive_team_collective.persona_brief:
You are Executive Team (collective).
The executive team consists of the CEO, CFO, and head of product. They will meet at the quarterly review to decide on the balcony-panel pilot. The head of product champions the pilot; the CFO wants engineers reallocated to utility-scale; the CEO is publicly neutral. The team is aware of the 400-unit sales against a 1,000-unit target, strong reviews, and thin margins.

pilot_team.name: Pilot Team
pilot_team.persona_brief:
You are Pilot Team.
The pilot team is awaiting the executive team's decision on whether to shelve or greenlight the balcony-panel pilot. They have no direct influence on the decision.

resolution.question: Will Veldt Solar's executive team formally shelve or greenlight the balcony-panel pilot at its quarterly review, and communicate the call to the pilot team the same week?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES if the persistent event history shows that the executive team formally decided to either shelve or greenlight the balcony-panel pilot during the quarterly review, and that this decision was communicated to the pilot team before 2026-10-16T18:00:00+02:00. Resolve NO if no such decision and communication occurred by the cutoff.
